title: Root-to-Leaf Paths with a Target Sum
statementHtml:
Problem statement

Source note: Reported in an Amazon new-grad onsite interview as Path Sum II. The source does not specify a tree encoding, empty-tree behavior, output order, or input bounds; this practice version uses a nullable level-order tree, returns matching paths in left-to-right depth-first order, and caps trees at 500 nodes with bounded node and target values. Problem match confidence: approximately 99%.

Given the root of a binary tree and an integer targetSum, return every root-to-leaf path whose node values add up to targetSum.

A leaf has no children. Return paths in left-to-right depth-first order, with each path listed from the root to its leaf.
